notes.title: Seeds of Unity Major Dev Update 4/22
notes.content:
[h1]Nitro10 Studios is Pleased to Announce a  Major Update on Seeds of Unity[/h1]
[previewyoutube=yr_PQrUBnsE;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]It All Started Two Years Ago[/h2]
Two years ago, we released the Seeds of Unity demo here on Steam. There was a lot of excitement from our team. We finally got the opportunity to have our passion project played by people around the world. Surely nothing could go wrong that day, right? [b]WRONG.[/b]
[h3]The Demo Wasn't Good Enough[/h3]
If anyone played the Seeds of Unity demo, you would remember that there were a lot of bugs, not much to do, poor art, and mechanics that felt rigid and frustrating. The team (two of us) got together in November of 2022 and came to a conclusion, [b]Seeds of Unity was not good enough in its current form.[/b] We had two choices, either scrap the project entirely, or [b]start all over and reinvent Seeds[/b]. We swallowed our pride and decided the latter option, took down the demo, and got to work.
[h2]So What's Changed?[/h2]
[b]EVERYTHING![/b] From the art, to the mechanics, to the music. Every single thing in Seeds has been changed and upgraded. It has changed so much that if you were to look at the old Seeds compared to the new one, you would say that they are different games. Here is a comparison just to show how much different it is.

[h2]New Mechanics[/h2]
There has been a lot of new changes to the mechanics of the game as well. Here is a list of some the new features that will be included in the game.
[list]
[*] Revamped farming system, giving the player the opportunity to customize their farm.
[*] Dialogue System has decision making, giving consequences to the player's choices.
[*] Heart event cutscenes with the residents of Raea.
[*] Animals!
[*] Festivals!
[*] Alien species that live in the "Real Raea"
[*] LORE!!!
[/list]
[h2]So What's Next?[/h2]
Seeds of Unity is still under development and is scheduled to be released in 2025. Our goal is to provide more exciting dev updates in the future, so please be on the lookout for that! To make sure to not miss a thing, please follow our [url=https://twitter.com/Nitro10Studios]Twitter.[/url]
Also please follow our portrait artist [url=https://twitter.com/GuardianOT_]GuardianOT![/url]

[h3]Nitro10 Studios thanks you for the support on Seeds of Unity and cannot wait to make Raea a reality![/h3]
